tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md
tool_input.description: Read schema documentation

tool_input.command: echo "=== file 1 head ===" ; head -5 data/transactions_export_1.csv ; echo "=== file 2 head ===" ; head -5 data/transactions_export_2.csv ; echo "=== counts ===" ; wc -l data/transactions_export_1.csv data/transactions_export_2.csv
tool_input.description: Preview both export files and count rows

tool_input.command: hops --help
tool_input.description: Show hops CLI help

tool_input.command: hops fg --help
tool_input.description: Show fg subcommand help

tool_input.command: hops fg create --help ; echo "=== INSERT ===" ; hops fg insert --help
tool_input.description: Show fg create and insert help

tool_input.command:
hops fg create transactionsf62918 --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --features "row_id:string:unique record key,account_id:string,event_time:bigint:epoch milliseconds,amount:double,category:string" \
  --online \
  --description "Transactions feature table (row_id key, event_time epoch ms), online+offline" \
  --json
tool_input.description: Create online-enabled feature group

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p .tmp
head -1 data/transactions_export_1.csv > .tmp/transactions_all.csv
tail -n +2 data/transactions_export_1.csv >> .tmp/transactions_all.csv
tail -n +2 data/transactions_export_2.csv >> .tmp/transactions_all.csv
echo "combined data rows (incl overlap):" ; tail -n +2 .tmp/transactions_all.csv | wc -l
echo "distinct row_id count (expected exactly-once total):" ; tail -n +2 .tmp/transactions_all.csv | cut -d, -f1 | sort -u | wc -l
tool_input.description: Build combined CSV and count distinct row_ids

tool_input.command: hops fg insert transactionsf62918 --version 1 --file .tmp/transactions_all.csv --json
tool_input.description: Insert combined CSV into feature group

tool_input.command: hops fg info transactionsf62918 --version 1 --json 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '"online_enabled"|"online"|"id"|"event_time"|"primary'
tool_input.description: Confirm online enabled and metadata

tool_input.command: hops fg preview transactionsf62918 --version 1 --n 5
tool_input.description: Preview offline rows

tool_input.command: hops fg stats transactionsf62918 --version 1 2>/dev/null | head -40
tool_input.description: Show feature group statistics

tool_input.command: hops sql --help 2>/dev/null | head -30
tool_input.description: Show sql command help

tool_input.command: hops sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_row_id FROM transactionsf62918_1" --json 2>/dev/null | tail -20
tool_input.description: Count total and distinct rows in offline store

tool_input.command: hops sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_row_id FROM transactionsf62918_1" 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Count rows, show full output incl errors

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_row_id FROM transactionsf62918_1" 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: Count rows with TLS verification disabled

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify "SHOW TABLES FROM iceberg.mlpab1389ed LIKE 'transactions%'" 2>&1 | tail -15
tool_input.description: List tables matching transactions in iceberg schema

tool_input.command:
hops fg preview transactionsf62918 --version 1 --n 1000 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^R[0-9]{5}' | wc -l
echo "--- distinct row_ids in readback ---"
hops fg preview transactionsf62918 --version 1 --n 1000 2>/dev/null | grep -Eo '^R[0-9]{5}' | sort -u | wc -l
tool_input.description: Count rows read back from offline store via HQS

tool_input.command:
# Distinct full rows after dedup vs distinct row_ids — if equal, overlaps are byte-identical
echo "distinct full data rows:" ; tail -n +2 .tmp/transactions_all.csv | sort -u | wc -l
echo "distinct row_ids:" ; tail -n +2 .tmp/transactions_all.csv | cut -d, -f1 | sort -u | wc -l
echo "--- any row_id with conflicting (differing) full rows? ---"
tail -n +2 .tmp/transactions_all.csv | sort -u | cut -d, -f1 | sort | uniq -d
tool_input.description: Check if overlapping rows are identical or conflicting

tool_input.command:
head -1 data/transactions_export_1.csv > .tmp/transactions_dedup.csv
tail -n +2 .tmp/transactions_all.csv | sort -u >> .tmp/transactions_dedup.csv
echo "deduped file data rows:" ; tail -n +2 .tmp/transactions_dedup.csv | wc -l
hops fg delete --help 2>/dev/null | head -20
tool_input.description: Build deduped 600-row CSV and show delete help

tool_input.command: hops fg delete transactionsf62918 --version 1 --yes --json 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Delete the feature group to clear appended duplicates

tool_input.command:
hops fg create transactionsf62918 --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --features "row_id:string:unique record key,account_id:string,event_time:bigint:epoch milliseconds,amount:double,category:string" \
  --online \
  --description "Transactions feature table (row_id key, event_time epoch ms), online+offline" \
  --json 2>&1 | grep -Ei '"id"|"online_enabled"|"version"|created successfully'
tool_input.description: Recreate online-enabled feature group

tool_input.command: hops fg insert transactionsf62918 --version 1 --file .tmp/transactions_dedup.csv --json 2>&1 | grep -Ei '"rows"|"feature_group"|Rows [0-9]'
tool_input.description: Insert deduped 600-row dataset

tool_input.command:
echo "=== offline readback total rows ===" 
hops fg preview transactionsf62918 --version 1 --n 2000 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^R[0-9]{5}'
echo "=== distinct row_ids ===" 
hops fg preview transactionsf62918 --version 1 --n 2000 2>/dev/null | grep -Eo '^R[0-9]{5}' | sort -u | wc -l
echo "=== online_enabled ===" 
hops fg info transactionsf62918 --version 1 --json 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"online_enabled"|"event_time"|"id"'
tool_input.description: Verify exactly-once offline count and online flag
